# tier 1, group bg30, route tour, version payload 1.3, role ab
# MSC_BG30=2 (default off until this run says yes; the owner's 14:04 decision makes it the live-play behaviour). Live-play pictures alternate FULL (the background - stadium, crowd, sky, far scenery - is kept in a 960x544 texture) and LIGHT (no background drawn: the kept one is re-projected to the new camera through the pitch plane; players, ball, items, shadows, nets, effects and HUD fresh). Read: [bg30] (renderer: full/light per 600, fallbacks must be 0 or explained, corner motion), [bg30g] (game: kinds, game thread ms a picture by kind, crowd/stadium skips), [lane] fps / game / GPU against d1 (expect a lower GPU and game-thread mean per picture), [present] hold mix, [speed], [hitch], [lat]. By eye: players and ball smooth, no edge smear, no flicker of goal posts over players. A crash or a black background in a light picture is a failure.
